---
title: "Median Household Income in Florida"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
  message: false
  warning: false
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)

fl_income <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = "B19013_001",
  state = "FL",
  year = 2022,
  geometry = TRUE,
  progress_bar = FALSE
)
```

This page shows county-level median household income across Florida from the U.S. Census Bureau's American Community Survey (`data.census.gov`, table `B19013`).

```{r}
fl_income |>
  ggplot(aes(fill = estimate)) +
  geom_sf(color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "magma",
    labels = scales::label_dollar()
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Median Household Income by County in Florida",
    subtitle = "2018–2022 American Community Survey (5-Year Estimates)",
    fill = "Median Income",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau (data.census.gov, Table B19013)"
  ) +
  theme_void()
```
